import Mathlib
open Complex Filter Function Metric Finset
open scoped BigOperators Topology
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem Shakarchi_exercise_1_19b (z : ℂ) (hz : ‖z‖ = 1) (s : ℕ → ℂ)
    (h : s = (λ n => ∑ i ∈ (range n), z ^ (i + 1) / (i + 1) ^ 2)) :
    ∃ y, Tendsto s atTop (𝓝 y) := by
  classical
  set f : ℕ → ℂ := fun n => z ^ (n + 1) / (n + 1 : ℂ) ^ 2 with hfdef
  
  have h_norm :
      (fun n : ℕ => ‖f n‖) =
        fun n : ℕ => (1 : ℝ) / (n + 1 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    funext n
    have hzpow : ‖z ^ (n + 1)‖ = 1 := by
      simp [hz, Complex.norm_pow z (n + 1)]
    have hdenpow :
        ‖(n + 1 : ℂ) ^ 2‖ = (n + 1 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      have hden : ‖(n + 1 : ℂ)‖ = (n + 1 : ℝ) := by
        simpa [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using
          (Complex.norm_natCast (n + 1))
      simp [pow_two, hden]
    calc
      ‖f n‖ = ‖z ^ (n + 1)‖ / ‖(n + 1 : ℂ) ^ 2‖ := by
        simp [f]
      _ = 1 / ‖(n + 1 : ℂ) ^ 2‖ := by
        simp [hzpow]
      _ = (1 : ℝ) / (n + 1 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
        simp [hdenpow]
  
  have h_pSeries :
      Summable fun n : ℕ => (1 : ℝ) / (n + 1 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    have h_base :
        Summable fun n : ℕ => (1 : ℝ) / (n : ℝ) ^ 2 :=
      (Real.summable_one_div_nat_pow (p := 2)).mpr one_lt_two
    simpa [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using
      (summable_nat_add_iff 1).2 h_base
  
  have h_norm_summable :
      Summable fun n : ℕ => ‖f n‖ := by
    simpa [h_norm] using h_pSeries
  
  have hfSummable : Summable f :=
    Summable.of_norm h_norm_summable
  
  refine ⟨∑' n, f n, ?_⟩
  have hy : HasSum f (∑' n, f n) := hfSummable.hasSum
  simpa [h, f] using hy.tendsto_sum_nat

import Mathlib
open Complex Filter Function Metric Finset
open scoped BigOperators Topology
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem Shakarchi_exercise_1_19b (z : ℂ) (hz : ‖z‖ = 1) (s : ℕ → ℂ)
    (h : s = (λ n => ∑ i ∈ (range n), z ^ (i + 1) / (i + 1) ^ 2)) :
    ∃ y, Tendsto s atTop (𝓝 y) := by
  let f : ℕ → ℂ := fun i => z ^ (i + 1) / (i + 1) ^ 2
  
  have hp : Summable (fun n : ℕ => 1 / ((n : ℝ) ^ 2)) :=
    (Real.summable_one_div_nat_pow (p := 2)).2 (by norm_num)
  
  have hp' : Summable (fun n : ℕ => 1 / ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
    simpa using (summable_nat_add_iff (G := ℝ) 1).2 hp
  
  have hnorm : ∀ i, ‖f i‖ ≤ 1 / ((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    intro i
    simp only [f, norm_div, norm_pow, hz, one_pow]
    have hi : (↑i + 1 : ℂ) = ↑(i + 1) := by
      norm_num
    rw [hi, Complex.norm_natCast]
  
  have hf : Summable f := hp'.of_norm_bounded hnorm
  
  let y : ℂ := ∑' i, f i
  refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
  rw [h]
  change Tendsto (fun n => ∑ i ∈ range n, f i) atTop (𝓝 y)
  exact (hf.hasSum).tendsto_sum_nat
